candidates.title: Mimi's Sticky Surprise
candidates.prompt: Mimi, an anthropomorphic bunny, is determined to stick a note labeled 'Topla!' to the toy cabinet. As she reaches out, the sticky note unexpectedly clings to her finger instead of the cabinet, creating a humorous moment. In a medium shot, Mimi struggles to peel the note away with her other hand, only for it to split into two, with one note sticking to each hand. A wide shot reveals Mimi pulling at the notes, which double in number with each tug, progressively covering her arms, legs, and face, leading to her feeling overwhelmed. In a close-up, Mimi sees her reflection in a mirror and screams in shock at being completely covered in notes. Finally, she sneezes, causing the sticky notes to scatter and stick to the cabinet, leaving her relieved yet the cabinet remains messy.

5-8s: Mimi continues to pull; each pull doubles the number of sticky notes [wide shot showing Mimi covered in notes] notes multiply from two to four as she pulls, progressively covering her arms, legs and face -> Mimi is overwhelmed by notes
8-10s: Mimi continues to pull; each pull doubles the number of sticky notes [wide shot showing Mimi covered in notes] notes multiply from four to eight as she pulls, progressively covering her arms, legs and face -> Mimi is overwhelmed by notes
10-12s: Mimi sees herself in a mirror and screams [close-up on Mimi's shocked face] Mimi is startled by her reflection completely covered in notes -> Mimi is startled
12-15s: Mimi sneezes and the sticky notes fly off [medium shot of notes flying] notes scatter and stick to the cabinet -> Mimi breathes a sigh of relief but the cabinet remains messy

AUDIO
Playful background music with sound effects for sneezing and notes sticking.

No dark themes or violence.

Mimi is relieved but the cabinet remains visibly messy.
